reasons: CS3241 prerequisite requires CS2030S or CS2030, but CS2030S is not completed and has no prerequisite in the list to allow it in Sem 1. CS2030S requires CS1010 which is not completed.
CS3268 prerequisite requires CS2109S or CS2109HS or CS3243, none of which are completed or planned, and their prerequisites (CS2040S etc) are also missing.
CS3103 prerequisite is CS2105, which requires CS2040 or CS2040S, which in turn require CS1010. CS1010 is not completed, making the entire chain impossible.
